name: YNX Security Platform
title: YNX Security Platform | Release Integrity and Reliability
metaDescription: Security, release integrity, observability, incident response, and recovery controls for YNX testnet products.
features: backup, restore, incident, and rollback controls
risks: current source artifact is test-signed, not production-signed
the source candidate is hosted as a mutable GitHub prerelease, not an immutable production artifact

faq.question: Is the YNX Security Platform publicly deployed?
faq.answer: No. The current source candidate is implemented, tested, clean-installed and centrally source-accepted, but shared Testnet, staging and public deployment are not verified.

faq.question: Is the current artifact production-signed?
faq.answer: No. The current source archive uses an ephemeral local test signature and is not eligible for public release.

faq.question: What release evidence is available?
faq.answer: The GitHub source prerelease includes a reproducible source archive, SHA-256 digest, CycloneDX SBOM, provenance statement, test-signature verification, tamper-rejection tests, and successful protected-branch CI. It is not production-signed.
